app: CDP 9345, Create at the story step: Continue to build; read the quote; Build and play (Qwen writes the origin with the Scene GBNF; the fixed parser reports every kind of mistake per round); wait for 'Your world is published' / Play / an error (up to 10 min); on an error press Build and play again (at most 3 builds in all); Enter the world; wait for Play; read the origin, the chapter status and what Qwen wrote

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<80;i++){const q=document.querySelector('[data-quote]'); if(q&&q.innerText.includes('This draft')) return q.innerText; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.querySelector('[data-quote]')?.innerText ?? document.body.innerText.slice(0, 1500);})()

repeat.until: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); return /Your world is published/.test(document.body.innerText) || S.useSessionStore.getState().screen==='play'})()

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); for(let i=0;i<2400;i++){const ms=Math.round(performance.now()-window.__q.b0); if(/Your world is published/.test(document.body.innerText)){window.__q.builds.push({published:ms, calls: window.__qcap.length-window.__q.cap0}); return window.__q.builds;} if(S.useSessionStore.getState().screen==='play'){window.__q.builds.push({play:ms, calls: window.__qcap.length-window.__q.cap0}); return window.__q.builds;} if(/Error · /.test(document.body.innerText) && !/Writing the place you wake in/.test(document.body.innerText)){window.__q.builds.push({errorAt:ms, calls: window.__qcap.length-window.__q.cap0, error: [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim())).map(e => e.parentElement?.innerText ?? e.innerText).slice(-1)[0]}); return window.__q.builds;} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return {timeout:true, body: document.body.innerText.slice(0,800)};})()

(async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); for(let i=0;i<960;i++){const s=S.useSessionStore.getState(); if(s.screen==='play'&&s.activeInstance){return {enterToPlayMs: Math.round(performance.now()-window.__q.e0), cartridge: s.activeInstance.cartridge.manifest.cartridgeId + '@' + s.activeInstance.cartridge.manifest.version, instance: s.activeInstance.instance.instanceId};} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return document.body.innerText.slice(0,600);})()
